snippet.title: Aloft – Critters & Wonders 🦋
snippet.description:
ALOFT - CRITTERS & WONDERS - OUT NOW
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1660080/Aloft/

Soar the skies in Aloft, the co-op sandbox survival game set in a world of floating islands. Build any island into a skyship, your home in the clouds. Find lost knowledge, cure the fungal corruption, and brave the hurricane to restore the ecosystem. Play solo or with up to 8 friends.

Join us in the skies:
http://www.discord.gg/aloft-game
https://x.com/Aloft_Game
